title: The new Pentair Pool 2026/27 catalogue is now available
summary: Pentair Pool is pleased to unveil its new 2026/27 catalogue, intended to support pool professionals in all their projects, from new builds to renovations. This new edition brings together all Pentair’s intelligent, high-performance and sustainable solutions, designed to simplify equipment management and optimise the pool experience.
body_markdown:
Pentair Pool is pleased to unveil its **new 2026/27 catalogue**


, intended to support pool professionals in all their projects, from new builds to renovations. This new edition brings together all **Pentair’s intelligent, high-performance and sustainable solutions**


, designed to simplify equipment management and optimise the pool experience.


Variable speed pumps, high-efficiency heating, high-performance filtration, automation, connected solutions and spare parts: the 2026/27 catalogue offers you a **complete and consistent range**


, backed by Pentair’s European expertise.
